dialogue.question: In the team-leaders scoreboard graphic, is the player from T1, T4, or T7 listed as a points leader?
In the graphic from T8, what historical milestone would a home-team win represent?
dialogue.answer: The on-screen graphic (UCF, vs RANKED OPPONENTS ALL-TIME WINS) shows UCF's all-time wins over ranked opponents: 2 before coach Dawkins and 10 under Dawkins.
